CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

2. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.
   C. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.

3. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

4. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   C. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

6. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   C. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

7. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   C. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.

8. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   C. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

10. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Replace drinking water

11. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   D. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.
   B. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Wind Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Football and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
